title: WAGR-432 (VIP manual entry flow) lacks the VIP rules decided on 2026-09-23/30: BA default, deal lookup filter, duplicate block, complete-in-one-pass

jira.summary: Sign-Up: VIP manual entry flow, field set, status, and Deal relation (VIP)
jira.quote: * Status: on manual creation, default directly to "In Progress" — no "New"/pending state, since this isn't coming from automated intake. Move to "Completed" or "Archived" from there using the existing status values; no new status values needed.

jira.summary: Sign-Up: VIP manual entry flow, field set, status, and Deal relation (VIP)
jira.quote: * Sign-up must be relatable to an existing Deal (the deal will already exist by the time ops logs the sign-up) — confirm the related-list/relationship UX once the New button and flow are in place.

what_differs: Meetings decided: the BA on a VIP sign-up defaults to the running user (changeable); the deal lookup lists only Active and Paused deals; a duplicate is the same player and same deal regardless of rep and the flow blocks it; users can fill all fields and complete in the same pass. WAGR-432 (created 09-23, no comments) states none of these rules, and the client has not yet confirmed whether VIP completion validation is the same as standard (L2958).
suggested_action: Add these rules as acceptance criteria on WAGR-432, and track the open VIP completion-validation confirmation (L2958) on the ticket.
